## Overview

This artifact runs **pgchecker** from [ReproMPI](https://github.com/hunsa/reprompi/tree/main/pgchecker) on a bare-metal cluster on Chameleon Cloud. pgchecker checks MPI libraries against self-consistent performance guidelines for collective operations (e.g. `MPI_Bcast`, `MPI_Allreduce`, `MPI_Allgather`): a collective should not be slower than an equivalent combination of other collectives.

The whole experiment runs end to end from one notebook:

1. **Provision**: reserve `compute_cascadelake_r` nodes (Mellanox ConnectX-6 InfiniBand), launch them from a prebuilt image, attach one Floating IP to the head node
2. **Configure**: `/etc/hosts`, node-to-node SSH, firewall for the MPI port range
3. **Validate**: hostname resolution, SSH and TCP between every node pair
4. **Run**: pgchecker via `experiment/run.sh` (Spack-built Open MPI 5)
5. **Collect**: results via rsync into `results/<experiment_id>/`
6. **Clean up**: servers and the lease are released automatically, also on errors

## Quick start

1. Click **Launch on Chameleon** and open `main.ipynb`.
2. In the **Settings** section, set `SITE` to `"CHI@UC"` or `"CHI@TACC"`. This is the only setting you need to change.
3. Run all cells.

## Experiment design

Runs are organised as a **k × i matrix**:

- **k**: number of independent allocations; the machines are reserved, set up and released k times, each allocation on different machines than the previous one.
- **i**: repetitions of the benchmark within one allocation.

This separates variation between machines/allocations from variation between runs on the same machines. Each run stores its full log, metadata (`run.json`), the raw `.dat` data and the resolved configuration under a unique experiment ID. `AnalyzeBestWorstRuns.ipynb` condenses the results into best/worst-case overhead tables per collective and message size, following Hunold et al., *Parallel Computing* 129 (2026) 103205.

## Requirements

- A Chameleon project with a bare-metal allocation at CHI@UC or CHI@TACC
- Default setup: 2 × `compute_cascadelake_r`, 48 MPI processes per node, 3 h lease
- Images (community, pgchecker preinstalled via Spack):
  - CHI@UC: `tuwien-pgchecker-uc-compute_cascadelake_r`
  - CHI@TACC: `tuwien-pgchecker-tacc-compute_cascadelake_r`

## Notes

- **Cost:** a run consumes bare-metal node hours from your allocation (2 nodes, up to 3 h by default). Cleanup runs automatically after every allocation.
- **Duration:** booting bare-metal nodes takes roughly 10–15 minutes per allocation before the benchmark starts.
- **Processes per node:** 48 per node is the tested default; pgchecker failed with the full 96 hardware threads per node.
- **Image:** the image is used as-is. Runtime settings (firewall, automatic updates paused during the run) are applied per allocation.
